shell_commands:
git add \
  specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md \
  specs/hal-engine-tool-budget/spec.md \
  specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md \
  src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts && \
  git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): correct PromptBuilder config and add missing spec links

Fix acceptance test to use correct PromptBuilder config property (identity instead of baseSystemPrompt). Consolidate multiple expect calls into single toEqual to comply with max-expects lint rule. Add spec statements and links for existing chatOrchestrator tests to resolve spec-link linter errors.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD

\
git add CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && \
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: document beforeSession behavior in spec and CHANGELOG

Update specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md to reflect that beforeSession hook behavior is now specified and guaranteed (no longer in the out-of-scope measured semantics section). Add CHANGELOG entry documenting the change: beforeSession now fires inside the try block so errors invoke onError and afterSession hooks, with migration guidance for existing consumers.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

git add .lore/dod.md && \
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore: mark all dod.md facets as complete

- Move beforeSession inside try block (previous round)
- Update spec with beforeSession guarantee (this round)
- Document CHANGELOG entry (this round)
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git status
